title: Level 4 (Abandoned Office), and Level 9's asphalt
note: review/baseline/4 was reshot in B7 on a build of unchanged main (the B0 set is kept in review/baseline/4-b0). B7 added close spots for a desk and chair, a cubicle, the partition rail, a filing cabinet, the water cooler, two posters, the extinguisher cabinet, a whiteboard and the hotel-red ramp. The asphalt family (Level 9, 9-day-street and 9-day-road-close) was re-done at the user's request after B11; its before is main (B11's asphalt). review/b7/sbs holds copies of both levels' shots side by side, the Level 9 ones prefixed 9-.
